neighbours.label: Title-case content words in a named title or heading, compared with the same kind of title written in sentence case.
fire: The reading group selected The Silent Orchard: A Season of Change.
The festival brochure announces A Window Into Tomorrow as its opening exhibition.
On the noticeboard, the lecture is listed as Cities: The Shape of Memory.
The librarian recommended The Last Lighthouse: Stories From the Coast.
Our magazine labels the feature A New Language of Gardens.
The museum program includes River Maps: A History of Exploration.
A poster near the entrance advertises The Hidden Geometry of Music.
The seminar handout carries the heading Work and Water: An Industrial Legacy.
